title: Can partial replacement keep up?
hook: Compare partial replacement with complete replacement under fixed removal.

doesNotKnow: Distinguish positive replenishment from replenishment sufficient to prevent depletion.

objective: Distinguish positive replenishment from replenishment sufficient to prevent depletion.

claims.text: Finite resource stocks constrain indefinitely maintained material throughput.
Donella H. Meadows, Dennis L. Meadows, Jørgen Randers and William W. Behrens III, The Limits to Growth (1972)
Partial replacement leaves {A}; full replacement leaves {B}. The first path loses five units per step until it reaches the nonnegative floor.
Does it hold up? This is stock accounting, not World3. It predicts no discoveries, substitution, prices or collapse date.
claims.source: {"type":"source-access-hold","note":"No empirical effect or research verdict established. Only bounded arithmetic proposed."}

recall.question: A store starts at 12, receives 1 and is asked for 4 each step. After four updates?
recall.why: Net change is −3 per step; the store reaches its zero floor.
